page.layout: One page of text, two columns of text is not used; a single column of running text with a centred division heading and a heading for the locus, followed by numbered paragraphs and scriptural references set as indented lines. Verse-number marks sit in the right margin (right side notes: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35). A running head at the top. Margin marks are numerals only, no note text.

main_text.p: Eph.2.v.14.15. Christus est pax nostra: qui utraq; fecit unum, & intergerini parietis septum soluit: inimicitias (id est, lege mandatorum quae in ritibus posita est) per carnem suam abolitis.

Coloss.2.v.14. & deinceps. Christus delevit, quod adversus nos erat chirographum, quod erat nobis contrarium: ipse vero cruci affixum sustulit. Ne quis igitur nos damnet ob cibum vel potum, &c. Quae sunt umbra rerum futurarum: corpus autem est Christi.

m) Gal.2.v.3. & deinceps. Sed neq; Titus, qui mecum erat, quamvis esset Graecus, coactus fuit circumcidi. Nempe propter irrepteptitios falsos fratres qui irrepserant, ad explorandum libertatem nostram quam habemus in Christo Iesu, ut nos in servitutem adigerent. Quibus ne ad momentum quidem nos subjiciendo cessimus; ut veritas evangelii permaneret apud vos.
main_text.head: LOCUS XXI.
De bonis operibus.
main_text.p: 1. Sanctificatio est, qua Deus in iustificatis, gratia sua cooperante, sanctitatem gratia operante datam, dirigit ad bona opera facienda.
Exod.31.v.13. Ego Dominus sum, qui sanctifico vos.
Et c.36.v.27. Spiritum meum ponam in medio vestri, quoafaciam ut in statutis meis ambuletis, & iura mea observetis, facientes ea.
Et c.37.v.38. Cognoscant gentes, me Dominum sanctificare Israelem, cum erit sanctuarium meum in medio ipsorum.
Luc.11.v.13. Si vos, qui mali estis, nostis bona dare liberis vestris: quanto magis Pater vester caelestis dabit Spiritum sanctum, petentibus ab ipso.
Ioh.17.v.17. Sanctifica, Pater, eos, tua veritate.
2.Cor.3.verf.5. Non sumus idonei per nos ipsos ad cogitandum quidquam, velut ex nobis ipsis: sed quod idonei sumus, idex Deo est.

page.notes: Right-margin marks 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 are verse-line numbers and are not transcribed as note text. Marginal numerals "II", "IO" and similar are line-counting marks. Some Latin words in the Coloss. and Gal. passages are doubtful due to the print: "irrepteptitios" is a printing/scan error for "irrepserant" context; the passage "Nempe propter irreptitios" is read as printed with [?] advised. Parts of the Eph. line and "Sed neq; Titus" are faint; "idex" in the Cor. line is as printed in the scan. Heading "LOCUS XXI." is set in capitals with spaced letters. The running head reads TRIUMPHUS. The catchword "Phil.4." is treated as a catchword at foot-right. Page 364 shows a bottom-right margin reference for a marginal note at line 10 not transcribed separately.
